clauses.reason: The single operative paragraph jointly exempts the employee and continues him in service until 1934-11-30. The matching recital confirms this one temporally limited exemption/continuation grant. This is an express temporal limit, not a performance deadline or evidence of actual service, retirement or death. Inclusive reading expires at the end of the stated day; the exclusive alternative expires at its start. No independent perpetual exemption or recurring command remains. No held evidence establishes an earlier cessation; bounded machine searches do not prove universal absence.
